question: In which of the following places, does the Hornbill Festival take place annually in the month of December?
solution:
The answer is __**Kohima.**__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hornbill Festival** is an annual festival celebrated from **1-10 December in Nagaland**.
 
• The festival has a great depiction of** inter-tribal ethnic groups**' customs and traditions.
 
• The main venue of the festival is the** kisama heritage village **present in the southern agami region of Kohima in Nagaland.
 
• The center of attraction in the festival is **Naga Morungs Exhibition**, **Miss Nagaland beauty contest**, **Naga Wrestling,** and indigenous sports.
 
• The Festival contributes greatly to the state's travel and tourism industry.
 
• The Festival is of great significance since it contributes to the integrity and well-being of different ethnic groups of Nagaland.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Assam is famous for its Majuli festival and Dehing Patkai Festival.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__ **

 
• **Haryana **is famous for its** Suraj Kund Mela** which brings in Arts and craft work from all over India.
 
• **Jammu and Kashmir **are famous for their** Dosmuchey festival and Matho Narang.**
